entities.summary: Christopher Gibson is a Finnish professional ice hockey goaltender for the Schwenninger Wild Wings in the Deutsche Eishockey Liga. Gibson was selected by the Los Angeles Kings in the second round of the 2011 NHL Entry Draft, although he never played for them, instead signing with the Toronto Maple Leafs, playing in their minor league system before a trade sent Gibson to the New York Islanders.
